greet: Quick word, {name}. I haven't got the time for a long one.
Ho, {name}. Make it snappy, I'm off within the hour.
Evening. Don't keep me, I've a letter to get over the pass.
{name}! You still here? Good, I'll not be long.
Right then, {name}, what is it? Out with it, I'm listening.
Friend. Quick now, my horse is already saddled.
{name}, you're in my way, but go on, say your piece.
Look sharp, {name}. The road doesn't wait for anyone.
Hail, {name}. Fast company is the only company I keep.
Well, {name}. Say it fast, I'm already halfway to the door.
accept: Done. Be quick about it, I've no patience for dawdling.
Aye, all right, {name}, and don't you dare slow me down.
Yes, yes, I'm in. Let's not waste the whole night on it.
Right you are, {name}. I'll give you until the next bell.
Agreed. Keep up, mind, I don't stop for stragglers.
All right, {name}, you've got me. Get on with it then.
Fine by me, {name}. Sooner started, sooner finished.
Aye. Hurry, the candle's burning down and so am I.
Yes. Go on then, {name}, before I think better of it.
Count me in, {name}, and mind you don't keep me long.
decline: No, {name}, I've not the time, I'm riding at first light.
No. Find someone with the patience for it, {name}.
Thanks, {name}, but no. I've had my fill of waiting for one day.
Not a chance, {name}. I'm on the margrave's business.
Sorry, {name}, I'd rather be on the road than stuck here.
No, {name}, and don't press me, I've heard enough arguments.
Pass, {name}. My hands are needed elsewhere, and so are my horses.
Not now, {name}. Another time, when the roads are quieter.
pressed: Hold on, I must go out a moment. Don't go anywhere.
Back in a breath. Mind my letters, I'll be right back.
Excuse me, I've got to step out. Won't be long.
Wait here, I must go out. Be back before you've finished.
Off for a moment. Keep your eye on my gear, {name}.
Sorry, {name}, I must go. Back in a tick, I swear it.
Give me a moment, I need to step outside. Quick as I can.
Hold that thought, {name}. I'll not be a minute.
Must go, must go. Back shortly, don't start without me.
content: Right, I've had my say and then some. Off I go, {name}.
That's enough talk for one night. Good evening to you, {name}.
I've listened long enough and talked longer. Time I was moving.
Well, {name}, that's me done for now. Take care of yourself.
I'll leave you to it, {name}. The road's calling and I answer.
Enough company for me tonight. Safe travels, {name}.
That's my piece said. I'm away, {name}, mind how you go.
I've kept you long enough, {name}. Good night, then.
Time for me to go, {name}. Some of us have work to do.
I'm off to the stables, {name}. Be well, and keep your hands warm.
closing: Bell's rung, so I'm off. Good night to you all.
Closing time, is it? Good night, then, and don't wait up for me.
That's the bell. Good night, all, I'm for the road.
Done for the night. Good night, and mind the cold on the pass.
Last call, and I'm gone. Good night to the lot of you.
Time's up, so I'm away. Good night, and sleep sound.
Right, the lamp's going out. Good night, all, and quick about it.
Bell's gone, I'm off. Good night, I've a horse waiting.
Shut up shop, is it? Good night, then, I'm riding at dawn.
Out with the lamps. Good night to you, I'm away.
